notes: County site is CivicPlus (co.irion.tx.us); its Elections > Notices page has a 'Results' tab listing only 2026 primary items: 'Unofficial March 3, 2026 Primary (PDF)', 'Unofficial March 3, 2026 Precinct by Precinct (PDF)' and hand count audit certifications. The server stamps every file with the request time as Last-Modified, so it gives no upload evidence. The precinct file is a scan (VersaLink C605) of a Hart 'Precinct Results Report ... Unofficial Results ... Run Time 7:58 PM Run Date 03/03/2026' with per-precinct Absentee, Early and Election Day votes, but the scan's CreationDate is 2026-03-04 15:43:21 UTC (9:43 AM CST March 4), so this file could not have been posted on election night. No 2024 general or 2026 runoff results are posted. No Clarity link. Check 3 pending (wayback-data branch not on origin). Rule 43 applied 2026-10-02 (normalize-1): 2026_primary LATER to UNDETERMINED.
